findings.description: Inside `__call__`, `max(max(0, self.min), min(result, self.max))` uses the builtins, which are fine only if `max` and `min` are not shadowed locally. `__init__` parameters named `max`/`min` shadow only inside `__init__`, so `__call__` is unaffected.
findings.rationale: No concrete trigger: `__call__` has no local `max` or `min`, so the builtins are used correctly. This is not a defect.
